[[Nevermore]] is a [[Legendary weapon|legendary]] staff crafted in the [[Mystic Forge]], through various materials and tasks tied to the [[Guild Wars 2: Heart of Thorns|Heart of Thorns]] expansion.

== Lore ==
{{Legendary unlock text|Nevermore is a living reminder that there's always a purpose to [[Raven (Spirit of the Wild)|Raven's]] riddles and tests. When you're mired in despair, lost for answers, he pushes because he knows you can fly.}}

== Graphics ==
Nevermore is a rune-inscribed raven staff. While stowed, three glowing cyan orbs float among the branches of the staff; and an animated raven is perched on the center branch. While drawn, the cyan orbs and raven are replaced by a spirit raven that encompasses the staff.

;Aura
* The arm wielding Nevermore is covered in black feathers.
* While drawn, ravens continuously fly in the sky above the wielder.

;Draw/Stow effects
* When drawn, the perched raven flies upwards and the three glowing orbs spiral towards it. On impact, the raven dissipates in a burst of cyan feathers, and forms the spirit raven. In addition, a conspiracy of ravens fly above the user and cawing is heard.
* When stowed, the raven re-materializes and perches on the staff, and cawing is heard.

;Footfalls
* The user leaves behind wisps of cyan feathers.

;Skill effects
* Default class weapon trails are replaced with a cyan mist and feathers.
* Critical hit attacks will spawn faint spirit ravens on the attacked enemy that fly away quickly.
* Default projectiles are replaced with spirit ravens that transform into glowing spheres mid-flight. Additionally, up to three ravens will fly out of the sky and trail the projectile. This effect changes the following skills:
**{{w}} [[Warrior]]: {{Skill icon|Snap Pull}}
**{{g}} [[Guardian]]: {{Skill icon|Bolt of Wrath}}, {{Skill icon|Searing Light}}, and {{Skill icon|Seeking Judgment}}.
***{{dragonhunter}} [[Dragonhunter]]: {{Skill icon|Spear of Justice}}.
**{{re}} [[Revenant]]: {{Skill icon|Essence Sap}} (downed skill), and {{Skill icon|Rejuvenating Assault}}'s whirl finishers.
***{{renegade}} [[Renegade]]: {{Skill icon|Citadel Bombardment}}.
**{{druid}} [[Druid]]: projectiles that pass through {{Skill icon|Sublime Conversion}}, and {{Skill icon|Throw Dirt}} (downed skill).
**{{daredevil}} [[Daredevil]]: Projectiles acquired through {{Skill icon|Steal}}, and {{Skill icon|Trail of Knives}} (downed skill).
**{{n}} [[Necromancer]]: {{Skill icon|Dhuumfire (death shroud skill)|Dhuumfire}}, {{Skill icon|Dark Path}}, {{Skill icon|Life Blast}} and {{Skill icon|Necrotic Grasp}}.
***{{harbinger}} [[Harbinger]]: {{Skill icon|Dark Barrage}}, {{Skill icon|Tainted Bolts}}.
**{{e}} [[Elementalist]]: {{Skill icon|Chain Lightning}}, {{Skill icon|Fireball}}, {{Skill icon|Gust}}, {{Skill icon|Shockwave}}, {{Skill icon|Stoning}}, and {{Skill icon|Water Blast}}.
***{{tempest}} [[Tempest]]: the first whirl finisher of {{Skill icon|Overload Fire}}, but not subsequent ones.
***{{weaver}} [[Weaver]]: {{Skill icon|Monsoon (weaver skill)|Monsoon}}, {{Skill icon|Plasma Blast}}, {{Skill icon|Pressure Blast}}, and {{Skill icon|Pyroclastic Blast}}.
**{{m}} [[Mesmer]]: {{Skill icon|Winds of Chaos}}.
***{{virtuoso}} [[Virtuoso]]: {{Skill icon|Bladesong Dissonance}}, {{Skill icon|Bladesong Harmony}}, {{Skill icon|Bladesong Sorrow}}.

== Notes ==
* {{Precursor stat change warning text}}
* The ravens spawned flying around the enemy after a critical hit scale with the size of that enemy's model. As such, they are almost imperceptible on small enemies like [[Lashtail Devourer]]s, and massive on enemies like the [[Legendary Icebrood Construct]].
{{Anomaly|Critical hits of [[Weakening Whirl]] no longer create ravens briefly flying around the target. It is unknown when this change occurred, but it can be argued that it was intentional so as to reduce visual clutter due to the skill having no recharge and hitting three times.
}}

== Trivia ==
* The staff is named for [[w:Edgar Allan Poe|Edgar Allan Poe]]'s poem "[[w:The Raven|The Raven]]", which frequently repeats the word "nevermore."<ref>[https://youtu.be/6kbTbs3YC_g?t=47m01s Guild Chat episode 19]</ref>
* The staff's skin was datamined from a test server in December 2013 and was referred to by the community as the "Raven Staff" until it was revealed to be the legendary weapon Nevermore in October 2015.
* After its release, more friendly ravens appeared all over Tyria: for example, there's now one on the Marriner's Plaque that was once the statue of Cobiah Marriner.
* There was a Guild Wars Prophecies Game of the Year bonus item called the [[gww:Nevermore Flatbow|Nevermore Flatbow]].
